description: This file contains abstract base class and concrete test classes for testing silo liveness detection and membership management in Orleans clusters, including scenarios like silo restart, kill, and membership grain behavior.

classes.name: LivenessTestsBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common setup and test methods for silo liveness and membership tests.

classes.name: LivenessTests_MembershipGrain
classes.description: Derived test class focusing on membership grain with specific gateway preferences and related liveness tests.

classes.name: ClientConfigurator
classes.description: Configures client builder to set preferred gateway index for testing.

methods.name: Do_Liveness_OracleTest_1
methods.description: Tests silo shutdown and verifies status updates.

methods.name: Do_Liveness_OracleTest_2
methods.description: Tests silo restart or kill and verifies cluster liveness.

methods.name: Do_Liveness_OracleTest_3
methods.description: Tests stopping and restarting silos, verifying message traffic.

methods.name: TestTraffic
methods.description: Sends test traffic to grains to verify cluster operation.

methods.name: SendTraffic
methods.description: Sends traffic to a specific grain key, optionally starting timers.

methods.name: LogGrainIdentity
methods.description: Logs grain identity details for debugging.
